name: browser-use
headline: Frappe Apps Manager - Automate Frappe Development
short_description: Frappe Apps Manager is a Claude Code plugin for Frappe Framework development. It offers 15 commands, 10 agents, and 15 skills to streamline the entire software development lifecycle. It benefits developers and operations teams by automating repetitive tasks, enhancing productivity, and ensuring consistency in Frappe/ERPNext application development.
author: Venkateshvenki404224

sections.overview:
Frappe Apps Manager extends Claude Code with specialized capabilities for the complete Frappe Framework development lifecycle. The plugin provides 15 commands for site management, app creation, testing, debugging, and production deployment, plus 10 specialized agents for architecture, security, performance, and DevOps. Developers and operations teams use it to automate repetitive tasks like DocType generation, API endpoint creation, test generation, and database migrations. It includes 15 autonomous skills for workflows, webhooks, data migration, and custom reports, all grounded in 120+ core app references and 175+ working code examples from ERPNext.
Create new Frappe apps and DocTypes with automated JSON generation
Generate unit tests, integration tests, and run coverage reports
Build REST APIs, webhooks, and external API connectors
Manage site configuration, database migrations, and Redis cache
sections.setup:
No install command available. Check the GitHub repository for manual installation instructions.
`git clone https://github.com/Venkateshvenki404224/frappe-apps-manager`
sections.usage:
```
Using the Frappe Apps Manager plugin, [ACTION] for my [PROJECT_NAME] project. [ADDITIONAL_DETAILS].
```
Copy

```
Sure, I can help with that. Here's how I would approach it:

1. First, I'll need to understand the current state of your project. Could you please provide me with the project directory or repository URL?
2. Once I have access, I'll use the Frappe Apps Manager plugin to [ACTION].
3. I'll ensure that the changes are consistent with the rest of your project and won't cause any conflicts.
4. After making the changes, I'll test them to make sure everything works as expected.
5. Finally, I'll provide you with a summary of the changes made and any next steps you should consider.
```
requirements: Claude Code or compatible AI agent
